paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate, Strategic Finance role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Ramp builds finance tools for finance teams, so the work of a strategic finance group there feeds straight into the product's own story, which is a big part of why I'm interested.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%, and built AI powered dashboards that automated reporting. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment, and benchmarked past allocations to find 30% efficiency gains that guided reinvestment.

That maps to planning, scenario work and helping leaders decide where the next dollar goes. I move fast with data and like automating the repetitive parts so the analysis gets the time. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
